description: SQL 생성을 위한 Few-shot 예시 쌍

examples.question: 모든 사용자를 조회해줘
examples.sql: SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

examples.question: 오늘 가입한 사용자는?
examples.sql: SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM users WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() LIMIT 100

examples.question: 이번 달 총 매출은?
examples.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) as total_revenue FROM payments WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE())

examples.question: 최근 7일간 결제한 사용자 목록
examples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username, u.email FROM users u INNER JOIN payments p ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) LIMIT 100

examples.question: 가장 많이 결제한 상위 10명의 사용자
examples.sql: SELECT u.id, u.username, COUNT(p.id) as payment_count, SUM(p.amount) as total_amount FROM users u INNER JOIN payments p ON u.id = p.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10
